dray.definition: n. a low heavy horse cart without sides; used for haulage
dray.translation:
n. 运货马车, (载货的)雪橇
vi. 以运货马车运
vt. 用马车运载

drayage.definition:
n. Use of a dray.
n. The charge, or sum paid, for the use of a dray.
drayage.translation:
n. 运货马车运送
[经] (货物的)马车运送, 运货马车运费

drayhorse.translation:
na. 重型挽马
[网络] 运货马车的马

drayman.definition: n. A man who attends a dray.

drays.definition: n. a low heavy horse cart without sides; used for haulage
drays.translation: n. 运货马车, 一种撬( dray的复数形式 )

drayton.translation: 德雷顿(①姓氏 ②Michael, 1563-1631, 英国诗人)
